stack.note: The web3d suite defaults to Next.js. GitGlobe's web layer is a client-only WebGL app with no SSR surface to gain, so Vite is used instead. Revisit at Phase 5, when the agent endpoint may want colocated API routes.

artDirection.mood: ice giant in a nebula — deep, banded, quiet
artDirection.reference: Neptune (Voyager 2) for the body; populous.com/explore for the chrome and the black-space discipline
artDirection.notes: Neptune's look is LOW band contrast, methane cirrus above the bands, and a few dark storm ovals. Crank the contrast and it becomes a beach ball. Everything stays under 0.55 luminance so 100k nodes remain the brightest things on screen.
artDirection.typography: Editorial sans for names and headlines; monospace strictly for telemetry. Monospace-only always reads as a terminal.
artDirection.entry: Intro overlay with headline + '↳ Start'. The camera reveal is the first thing the product does.

decisions.why: Full shader control for the nebula aesthetic; deck.gl's _GlobeView is experimental and geo-oriented. Fallback retained if Phase 0 fails at 1M.

decisions.decision: Quantised (theta, phi, size) ride inside the `position` attribute as Uint16
decisions.why: three.js needs a position attribute for draw count. Making it carry real payload costs 6 bytes/point instead of 12 wasted on dummy xyz.

decisions.decision: GLSL ES 1.00 with an explicit Float32 index attribute, not GLSL3 + gl_VertexID
decisions.why: 4 MB of VRAM at 1M points is cheaper than a class of silent compile differences across drivers.

decisions.decision: GPU picking on a dedicated layer, 1x1 scissored target, 30Hz, skipped during camera flights
decisions.why: Raycasting 1M points is impossible. Readback stalls the pipeline, so it is throttled and suppressed when the frame budget is tightest.

decisions.decision: Node size from log-scaled Pareto stars, one global monotone scale across LOD bands
decisions.why: pow(rnd(), k) saturates the top of the range — verify-tiles caught every top-2% repo landing in [0.975, 1.000]. Band-local rescaling would break size comparability across an LOD boundary.

decisions.decision: Edges live in graph.bin, separate from tiles
decisions.why: Tiles stay a pure spatial-visual record. Mirrors production, where edges are in Postgres and never enter a tile.

decisions.decision: One GPU-resident ribbon mesh; slerp, lift and pulse all computed in the vertex shader
decisions.why: Animation costs one uniform per frame. Hovering a 600-neighbour hub costs the same as a leaf.

decisions.decision: PageRank drives node size, LOD banding, and edge selection — not edge existence
decisions.why: PageRank ranks nodes. What it can honestly decide is which of the edges are worth drawing, which is what makes a hairball legible.

decisions.decision: Pick padding 5px to 2.5px, plus size-biased depth
decisions.why: The 5px hit area captured neighbours 2-3px from the cursor, so the highlight visibly snapped off-target.

decisions.decision: Three layers — gridded core, hard rim (pow 9), wide scatter (pow 2.6)
decisions.why: A single Fresnel shell has no edge, so the eye never finds the horizon and it reads as a lamp.

decisions.decision: Gate on dropped frames and a headroom probe, not on p95 frame interval
decisions.why: rAF is vsync-locked, so the interval measures the display not the scene. The old gate was unpassable on a 60Hz monitor and told us nothing about margin.

decisions.decision: Fixed world-space sun direction shading the core, all three shells, and the points
decisions.why: Without a light direction the sphere is uniformly dark and reads as a flat disc regardless of how good the rim is. Camera-relative light would look identical from every angle and defeat the purpose.

decisions.decision: Top bar with domain tabs; all diagnostics behind a toggle
decisions.why: Two dense always-on panels is what made it read as a debug tool. Populous keeps almost nothing on screen.

decisions.decision: Terrain baked once into a 2048x1024 equirectangular RGBA texture; RGB albedo, A city lights
decisions.why: Per-fragment fBm plus a 64-cluster loop is unaffordable per frame and trivial as a one-time pass. One texture fetch afterwards.

decisions.decision: Continents grow from cluster potential, so territories ARE sectors
decisions.why: Makes the semantic map literal. Also forced a real fix: domains were assigned by cluster index, scattering each domain across the globe and breaking fly-to-domain.

decisions.decision: scripts/preview-planet.ts renders the same formula in Node and fails on bad land fraction
decisions.why: The first shader produced 100% land. Without a headless render nobody finds that until they open a browser.

decisions.decision: Gas giant instead of a terrestrial planet; territories are weather systems, not continents
decisions.why: Latitudinal banding plus differential-rotation shear is far more beautiful than coastlines, and territory tint inside the bands keeps sectors legible without the planet becoming a paint chart.

decisions.decision: Auto-rotation pauses on ANY pointer activity, not just hover, and resumes after 4s with a 1s ramp
decisions.why: Gating on hover alone still let the target slide away while you were reaching for it. Aiming at a node had become a chase.

decisions.decision: Two thresholded noise fields plus a galactic-plane band, drawn on a camera-locked box at gl_Position.xyww
decisions.why: A starfield on flat black reads as a screensaver. Depth and orientation in the sky make the planet look like it is somewhere.
